description.title: Snuggle Sorcery · Full playthrough, Part 1: The Rainy Train and the Night Market (no commentary)
description.text:
Part 1 of 5 of a full playthrough of Snuggle Sorcery: the Prologue and Chapters 1 and 2. Spoilers!

Snuggle Sorcery is a cozy story game in your browser: in the misty harbour city of Lantern Bay, curses born from small worries come out fluffy, and you soothe them by humming a lullaby. Free, no install, no account: https://sn0.maize.live

Played by the game's own autoplayer: a script that plays from what is on screen, like a first-timer.
